intraday_block_caveat: DAY_4_5 BTC high is USER_VERIFIED_APPROXIMATE and excluded from exact scoring; daily OHLC blocks support coarse containment, not exact sequence.
cross_source_rule: Do not silently merge Yahoo daily-OHLC actuals with Binance CEST candle actuals inside one score.
precision_rule: ACTUAL_RANGE_VERIFIED does not equal forecast accuracy unless prior Forecast Ledger is loaded. If prior forecast is missing, mark FORECAST_LEDGER_MISSING and RANGE_SCORE_PARTIAL, not PRICE_UNVERIFIED.
